summary: NetBird is a zero-trust networking platform that connects people, machines, and AI agents across any network. From versions 0.5.0 through 0.75.1, the client daemon exposes its gRPC control interface to any local process without authentication. On Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD, the interface is a Unix domain socket that is accessible to all local users, allowing any of them to control the daemon. An attacker with a low-privilege account can read or modify privileged VPN and daemon settings, disconnect or hijack the NetBird peer, and gain an unauthenticated root shell via the built-in SSH server. This issue is fixed in version 0.76.0.

An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes, with the practical impact depending on what the empty value selects in the application. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. title: CVE-2026-137490 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a query injection vulnerability that allows low-privilege or anonymous users to inject AQL or SQL by supplying unescaped parameters to ArangoDB and Snowflake queries. Attackers can execute published queries with crafted parameter values to bypass filters, read entire datasources, and modify or delete all stored documents.
title: CVE-2026-137491 (CVSS 8.1)

summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows workspace-scoped builders to access other workspaces' backups by supplying a foreign backupId. Attackers can substitute predictable backup IDs in backup download, import, update, or delete routes to steal archives, restore victim data into their workspace, or delete backups.
title: CVE-2026-137492 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: Budibase server from 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows view users and anonymous visitors to access entire base tables by passing a view id to the /api/:viewId/rows routes. Attackers can read, export, modify, and delete rows outside the view filter, including hidden columns, or read the full table unauthenticated through PUBLIC views.
title: CVE-2026-137493 (CVSS 8.1)

summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve legacy LiteLLM credentials by querying the public settings endpoint. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to /api/global/configs/public to obtain liteLLM.keyId and secretKey, enabling unauthorized use of tenant LiteLLM resources.
title: CVE-2026-137497 (CVSS 7.5)

summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a JSON injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JSON structure into S3 delete and Google Sheets row fields via unescaped template parameters. title: CVE-2026-137503 (CVSS 8.1)

summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authentication bypass in instance-level Google SSO because the id_token audience is not verified when no Google OAuth client ID is configured, the shipped default. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a Google-signed id_token minted for their own OAuth client to /api/sso/sign-in/common/google without an organizationId, obtaining a session as any existing user with the matching email.
title: CVE-2026-137523 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass in the internal database (TJDB) PostgREST proxy, which grants proxy access to every logged-in user and derives the database role and schema from the client-supplied tj-workspace-id header. Any authenticated workspace member can send requests to /api/tooljet-db/proxy/<tableId> to read and modify TJDB tables, bypassing app, query, and table permissions, and in SQL-mode-disabled (Cloud) deployments can access all tenants' tables.
title: CVE-2026-137526 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: Tornado before 6.6.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in StaticFileHandler on Windows that allows unauthenticated attackers to read NTFS Alternate Data Streams by appending :streamname to URL paths. title: CVE-2026-137540 (CVSS 5.3)

summary: Coder before 2.29.27, 2.30.0 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, 2.38.0 before 2.38.7, and 2.39.0 before 2.39.1 returns database connection errors containing a temporary AWS IAM database password in API key middleware responses. title: CVE-2026-137547 (CVSS 8.1)

summary: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a path traversal vulnerability in validateStackPath, which omits the isProtectedPath() check and permits writes to protected system directories. title: CVE-2026-137556 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 does not check oct key length in the AESKW, AESGCMKW, and experimental AESCTR and chacha20-poly1305 key encryption algorithms, so OpenSSL zero-pads short or empty keys. When an application uses an empty key, anyone can unwrap content encryption keys under the all-zero key to read issued tokens and forge accepted ones.
title: CVE-2026-137562 (CVSS 4.8)

summary: The Warehouse Cargo theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in versions up to, and including, 2.7.4 via the warehouse_cargo_install_and_activate_plugin() AJAX handler. The handler is registered on wp_ajax_ but performs no nonce verification and no capability check, allowing any authenticated user to supply an attacker-controlled URL that the server fetches, writes into wp-content/plugins/ with file_put_contents(), extracts with unzip_file() (which does not filter file extensions), and then activates via activate_plugin(). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to upload arbitrary files on the affected site's server which makes remote code execution possible.
title: CVE-2026-76075 (CVSS 8.8)

summary: The Apache Airflow TaskFlow decorators @task.bash, @task.sql, @task.analytics, @task.kubernetes_cmd and the common.ai decorators (@task.llm, @task.agent, @task.llm_sql, @task.llm_branch, @task.llm_file_analysis, @task.llm_schema_compare) rendered Jinja templates a second time after the task runner had already rendered them, so any value copied into env, op_args, op_kwargs or the returned prompt, command or SQL was evaluated as a template on the worker. An attacker who can only trigger a Dag run (for example a user with trigger permission supplying run conf), or who controls text that a Dag passes into one of these decorators as an argument or prompt (for example a ticket or a downloaded document), could run arbitrary commands on the worker and read connection passwords and Variables, in any deployment that uses an affected decorator in a Dag that passes such input through env, parameters or prompt. Users are recommended to upgrade apache-airflow-providers-standard to 1.22.0, apache-airflow-providers-cncf-kubernetes to 11.0.0, apache-airflow-providers-common-sql to 3.0.0 and apache-airflow-providers-common-ai to 1.2.0 or later.
